corrected_text: LiteRT-LM's CPU TopKTopPSampling (runtime/components/sampling_cpu_util.cc) with k == 1 returns the argmax token (found with MaxElement) with score 1, so p and temperature (once validated) don't affect it; with k > 1 it takes the top k, softmaxes them at the temperature, keeps the smallest prefix of the probability-sorted candidates whose cumulative probability reaches p, and samples one of them in proportion to its probability (a uniform draw over the kept cumulative mass), falling back to the most probable token if that mass is zero.
